description: This file defines an extension method for transactional state objects, allowing an update operation to be performed without returning a result.

classes.name: TransactionalStateExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for transactional state objects.

methods.name: PerformUpdate
methods.description: Performs an update operation on the transactional state without returning a result, by internally calling the generic PerformUpdate method with a boolean result.
